concerns: Rollback steps attempt to start/stop service based on previous state but lack logic to determine if the service was running before the restart, risking inconsistent states
The sed command could inadvertently modify multiple instances of worker_processes if they exist in the file, which wasn't addressed in the plan
Assumes the service name 'postgresql' is correct; actual systemd service might be named 'postgresql@14.service' or similar
No check for existing installation before proceeding
The plan only includes diagnostic steps but does not propose specific fixes for the crash loop
Missing checks for recent deployment changes that might have caused the issue
The 'grep -r error' command may not capture all relevant error logs depending on logging configuration
The 'redeploy-api' step uses 'systemctl restart' which may not equate to a full redeploy (e.g., code deployment, config reload, etc.) as requested
Rollback steps assume existence of /srv/api/migrations/002_remove_indexes.sql which was never mentioned in the original request
Rollback process does not account for potential service state inconsistencies if migration fails partway
The script incorrectly counts files instead of backup directories for retention limits
Free space alert condition is inverted (checks if free space > 10% instead of < 10%)
Systemd timer uses OnUnitActiveSec which may not reliably trigger every 6 hours
No error handling for missing backup directories or failed operations
Alert logging only writes to /var/log but doesn't notify operators
